description: Fixture corpus for the Recall-MCP golden-set retrieval eval (authored alongside evals/golden.json; the eval test seeds these memories verbatim into a fresh SQLite store).

memories.text: The deploy pipeline runs on Thursday afternoons; rollbacks take about ten minutes through the ops console.
Postgres connection pool size is capped at 20 per service instance; raise it with the database team first.
The staging environment database lives on the shared virtual machine, snapshot it before schema migrations.
Feature flags are stored in the flags table and cached for five minutes in the api service.
Rust workspace layout decision: pure core crate, server crate for axum, cli crate for scripting.
Rate limiting kicks in at 100 requests per minute per api key; return 429 with a retry-after header.
The websocket gateway reconnects with exponential backoff starting at 250 milliseconds.
Cron jobs run in utc on the scheduler box; never schedule anything at midnight utc on the first of the month.
Logging goes through the tracing pipeline; spans carry a request id that matches the gateway logs.
Terraform state for the queue infrastructure is in the s3 bucket infra-tfstate, lock with dynamodb.
The mobile client targets ios 17 and android 14; older versions get the maintenance screen.
Cache invalidation for the search index happens through the reindex endpoint, not by hand editing redis.
Load test results from june: the api gateway saturated at 3000 requests per second with p95 at 40 milliseconds.
Kubernetes namespace prod-eu runs three replicas of the billing worker behind the payments queue.
The single sign on integration uses oidc against the company identity provider, token lifetime is one hour.
Database backups run nightly at 02:00 and are retained for thirty days in cold storage.
The onboarding flow was shortened to three steps after the march usability study.
Pricing tiers: starter is free, team is twelve dollars per seat, enterprise is negotiated annually.
The beta program for the reporting dashboard starts in q3 with fifty design partner customers.
Churn interviews show the top reason for leaving is missing calendar integrations.
Roadmap priority for q4 is the notification center, then saved views, then the mobile refresh.
The docs site search is powered by the same hybrid retrieval engine as the assistant.
Support tickets tagged billing are routed to the finance rota every morning at nine.
The waitlist grew to four thousand signups after the launch post hit the front page.
Accessibility audit fixes are tracked in the a11y epic; keyboard navigation was the biggest gap.
The export feature ships csv and json; pdf export is deliberately out of scope for now.
Customer advisory board meets quarterly; the next session focuses on workflow automation requests.
The trial length is fourteen days, extendable to thirty by the sales team for enterprise prospects.
Dentist appointment is booked for the tenth of october at nine in the morning on birch street.
The climbing gym membership renews in november; cancel before then if the shoulder has not healed.
Passport expires next summer; renew it before the spring trip planning starts.
Favorite coffee beans are the ethiopian light roast from the roastery on the market square.
Standing reminder: water the plants every sunday evening, the ferns need less than the herbs.
The landlord prefers maintenance requests by email, not the portal; include photos up front.
Book club meets the first tuesday of each month; this month we are reading the short history novel.
Tax documents folder lives in the cloud drive under finance and the accountant needs them by march.
Running plan: three easy five kilometer runs per week, one long run on saturdays.
The car service is due after fifteen thousand kilometers; the mechanic on oak road is reliable.
Gift idea for mom: the ceramics workshop in december, she mentioned wanting to try pottery.
Preference for meetings: no meetings before ten in the morning, deep work block from eight to ten.
